description.value:
You fling a bubble of acid at one creature within range, or split it between two creatures standing within 5 feet of each other. Each target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 acid damage.

The damage increases to 2d6 at 5th level, 3d6 at 11th level, and 4d6 at 17th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, At-Will
